anatomy_notes.source: Direct Time Stranger chr192 model and native 2.000000127-second chr192_bn01 loop; four endpoint-exclusive samples.
anatomy_notes.bind_axis: Bind head and chin lie at Z+1.54 to +1.66, front wrists at Z+0.90, hind ankles at Z-1.22 and tail tip at Z-5.63. Camera azimuth 0 sees +Z, so Down is frontal; 270/90 are opposing screen profiles; 180 sees the rear.
anatomy_notes.face: Source eye_L and eye_R meshes are present; evaluate their native-scale contrast before any source-bounded treatment.
anatomy_notes.silhouette: Preserve native head, jaw, armored limbs, claws, long tail and sword detail.
anatomy_notes.offsets: Native J_head, J_center and J_wrist_l/r provide projected PMDO markers.
anatomy_notes.ground: Native Idle holds all paws in a suspended pose while the tail hangs lower. Use one fixed airborne transform and a 7 px minimum shadow gap; do not ground the tail tip.
